name: barbell pullover v. 2
description: A pullover with a barbell lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.
